test_message: Validate this data: Swift payment confirmation #PAY-2026-001, amount $150,000, date 2026-01-15, vendor ABC Corp. Accounting ledger entry #LED-5432, budget code MKT-Q1, allocated $120,000. Insurance PDF: Policy #INS-9876, renewal date 2026-01-10, status pending.

Insurance policy renewal date (2026-01-10) is prior to the Swift payment date (2026-01-15); potential mismatch in transaction-related timing.
